question: Does 'fully rewritten into Rust' include the browser screens (React frontend), or only the behind-the-scenes engine (API/parsers/database)?
probes: Ask the person with core_person_ask, offering: Rust engine only + keep screens; Rust engine + Rust-built screens; Rust engine + simpler built-in screens
resolution: Decided by the builder (person asked me to decide): rewrite the whole server engine in Rust; keep the existing browser screens unchanged, since the browser is part of the app's architecture and a faithful visual rebuild requires keeping them. Rust cannot run directly in a browser; a Rust/WASM rewrite would change the look and break likeness.
